> and search engines. Built ONLY from data published on this site

> or schedule is absent below, it is NOT published on the site —
> batches and unpublished fees are confirmed on enquiry, and nothing
> here has been guessed to fill a gap.

## Services

- [Corporate Trainings](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/corporate-trainings): Professional IT training programs for corporates and students across hardware, networking, cybersecurity, cloud computing, digital marketing and more.
- [Internships](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/internships): Internship programs offering exceptional learning opportunities and industry exposure.
- [Industrial Trainings](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/industrial-trainings): Practical training programs aligned to industry needs for students and working professionals.
- [College Workshops](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/college-workshops): Technical workshops conducted for college students.
- [Cybersecurity Services](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/cybersecurity-services): Cybersecurity solutions for diverse organizations, addressing security needs with expertise and precision.
- [Web Development](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/web-development): Cost-effective solutions for premium web designs, featuring aesthetically pleasing themes.
- [Digital Marketing Solutions](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/digital-marketing-solutions): Cost-effective digital marketing services to enhance online presence and business performance.
- [Network Infrastructure Building](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/network-infrastructure-building): Efficient network infrastructure building services for businesses.
- [Logo Designing](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/logo-designing): Creative logo designing services that leave a lasting impression.
- [US IT Staffing](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/us-it-staffing): IT staffing services for US requirements.
- [Domestic Consultancy](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/domestic-consultancy): Consultancy services for domestic (India) opportunities.
- [Abroad Consultancy](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/services/abroad-consultancy): Consultancy services for overseas opportunities.

- [CEH vs Security+: Which Certification Should You Do First?](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/blog/ceh-vs-security-plus-which-first) (authored 2026-10-23): CEH teaches you to attack; Security+ teaches you to defend. A factual comparison of focus, duration, certification and roles — from the two courses' own published pages.
- [What Does a SOC Analyst Actually Do?](https://gradespot-leo-build-app.vercel.app/blog/what-does-a-soc-analyst-do) (authored 2026-10-23): Monitoring, detection and response — the daily work of a Security Operations Centre analyst, explained through the topics and tools of a real SOC training syllabus.

## Frequently asked questions (site-wide)

### What training programs do you offer?

Our organization offers an array of professional training programs for both corporates and students. With our courses ranging from computer hardware, networking, cybersecurity, cloud computing, digital marketing, data science, and many more, we are dedicated to providing comprehensive and up-to-date expertise in various IT technologies. Our approach to training is geared towards providing practical skills and knowledge that will equip our clients to succeed in their respective fields. We pride ourselves on our commitment to maintaining a high standard of quality in all our training sessions, and our team of expert instructors are fully equipped to offer individualized attention and support to all our clients.

### What services do you offer?

Our company offers an extensive range of professional services that cater to diverse industry and business needs. These services include top-quality IT trainings, expert web development, robust cybersecurity solutions, innovative digital marketing strategies, efficient network infrastructure building, creative logo designing, and many more. Our team of experienced professionals prides itself on delivering comprehensive solutions tailored to your unique requirements. We ensure that each service we provide adheres to the highest industry standards and is designed to enhance your business operations and strengthen your brand.

### What's the best way to get in touch with your team?

To get in touch with us, we offer multiple channels of communication. You may reach us by phone at +91 91826 54056, or by email at info@gsitssolutions.com for any inquiries you may have. Additionally, you are more than welcome to visit us at our office located at 16-126, 2nd Floor, Near Sai Baba Temple, Road No.1, Sri Krishna Nagar, Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana - 500060. We are dedicated to providing exceptional service to our clients and we look forward to hearing from you.

### Do you offer online or offline classes?

Both. GradeSpot runs online and offline classes for its trainings from its institute in Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad — live sessions with recorded videos and hands-on labs.

### How do I know the current batch schedule?

Batch schedules are confirmed on enquiry — call +91 91826 54056 or send an enquiry and the team will share the current batch schedule.

### Can I attend a free demo class?

Yes. GradeSpot offers a free demo class — register on the site and the team confirms the demo timing by phone.

### What are the fees for a training?

Fees are published per course where a pricing section exists — for example the CCNA and CCNP plans on the course pages. For other trainings the fee is confirmed on enquiry — call +91 91826 54056. Nothing is charged before you confirm.

### Do your trainings prepare for certifications?

Yes — each training prepares you for the certification named on its course page, with exam-oriented preparation as published in the curriculum. GradeSpot certificates can be verified by code on the certificate verification page.

### Do you guarantee placements?

No. GradeSpot publishes the job roles each training prepares you for and the companies its students work with, and backs preparation with hands-on labs, certification guidance and career-oriented services — but it publishes no placement percentages and guarantees no job.

### Complete Digital Marketing — FAQ's

paragraphs

### Complete Digital Marketing — Who is eligible to enroll in the Digital Marketing Training Program?

Our training program is open to individuals from all backgrounds and skill levels. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced professional looking to enhance your digital marketing skills, our program is designed to accommodate learners at various stages of their career journey.

### Complete Digital Marketing — Do I need any prior experience or knowledge in digital marketing to join the program?

No prior experience in digital marketing is required. Our training program is structured to cater to learners with diverse backgrounds. We provide comprehensive instruction starting from the fundamentals, making it accessible for beginners while also offering advanced topics for experienced professionals.

### Complete Digital Marketing — What learning resources are provided during the training?

Throughout the program, you will have access to a variety of learning resources including lecture materials, video tutorials, case studies, practical exercises, and supplementary reading materials. Additionally, you'll have access to digital marketing tools and platforms for hands-on learning.

### Complete Digital Marketing — How long does it take to complete the Digital Marketing Training Program?

The duration of the training program is 45 days. During this time, you will cover all the essential topics in digital marketing, gaining both theoretical knowledge and practical skills through hands-on projects and exercises.

### Complete Digital Marketing — Will I receive a certificate upon completion of the training program?

Yes, upon successful completion of the Digital Marketing Training Program, you will receive a course completion certificate from GradeSpot IT Solutions. This certificate serves as a testament to your skills and knowledge acquired during the training.

### Complete Digital Marketing — Is job placement assistance provided after completing the training?

Yes, we offer job placement assistance to our graduates. Our dedicated career support team provides assistance with resume building, interview preparation, and job placement opportunities within the digital marketing industry.

### Complete Digital Marketing — How is the training delivered?

The training is delivered through a combination of live instructor-led sessions, pre-recorded video lectures, interactive workshops, and hands-on practical exercises. Sessions are conducted both online and in-person, providing flexibility for learners to choose the mode of participation that best suits their schedule.

### Complete Digital Marketing — How can I enroll in the Digital Marketing Training Program?

To enroll in the program, simply visit our website or contact our admissions team for assistance. You can fill out the enrollment form online and complete the registration process to secure your spot in the upcoming batch of the training program.
